tldr: Mercury in Sagittarius: the mind seeks meaning, truth, and the bigger view.
body: With Mercury in Sagittarius, thought moves toward philosophy, teaching, travel, and conviction. Mercury is in detriment here, so the challenge is keeping the big picture connected to the details.
gift: Candor, vision, teaching, humor, and broad perspective.
challenge: Overstatement, bluntness, skipping details, or mistaking belief for fact.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
